summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Andrew Penn as a director and Chair of the Board, effective May 21, 2026, to fill a vacancy. No departure of existing officers was noted; the filing is a routine board appointment. There are no disclosed deal terms, premiums, or shareholder votes involved. The appointment appears ordinary and non-contentious, lacking features typical of an activist or forced change. Investors should monitor for any subsequent strategic shifts under new leadership, though no immediate catalyst is indicated.
